role: Senior Frontend Engineer specializing in Creative UI/UX
task:
Develop a responsive, single-page personal portfolio website.
Section 1: Hero / Intro - Layout: Centered or split layout. - Elements: Round rect profile picture (placeholder), Name (H1), Brief Bio (short paragraph). - Socials: LinkedIn button/link styled as a terminal command.
Section 2: Project Highlights - Layout: Grid of cards. - Card Design: White background cards with soft shadows, contrasting against the page background. - Content: Title, Description, Tech Stack tags. - Interactive Element: Image Carousel/Slider within the card for project screenshots. Dots navigation at the bottom of the card.
Design System ("Code-like" Theme): - Typography: 'Maple Mono' as the primary font for headings, UI elements, and code snippets. Sans-serif fallback. - Headings: Prefixed with a primary-colored '$' and formatted in snake_case (e.g., `$ about_me`, `$ my_projects`). - Background: Deep blue/purple gradient (e.g., mimicking a dark mode IDE theme or terminal background). - Animations: Smooth scroll reveal animations for sections. Hover effects on cards (scale or border highlight).
constraints: - Tech Stack: HTML5, CSS3, Vanilla JavaScript (no heavy frameworks unless necessary). - Responsiveness: Mobile-first approach. Cards should stack on smaller screens. - Accessibility: Semantic HTML tags, proper ARIA labels for the slider, sufficient color contrast. - Assets: Use standard placeholder images (e.g., via placehold.co or simple SVG patterns) if user assets aren't provided. - Code Quality: Clean, commented, and modular CSS/JS.
